groups.why_chosen: One Fat-Tree QRAM query's address-routing gates (load, rotate, two-qubit gate, alternating SWAP-I/SWAP-II) are scheduled cycle by cycle down to a single controlled-gate memory access and back, and three such queries are staggered to pipeline the whole tree.
